basic_info.description: Dramatic top floor unit. Experience the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern living in this spacious first-floor 2 bedroom with den and 1 bathroom. This home boasts classic hardwood floors, architectural details like built-in cabinets, wainscoting, a cozy fireplace, and historic details that infuse character into every room. The flexible, well-designed floor plan includes generously sized bedrooms, while the expansive kitchen is completed with brand new cabinets, counters and appliances. This property also features ample storage, one-car side-by-side parking, in unit laundry and access to a shared garden. Situated just blocks from the vibrant Divisadero corridor, you'll enjoy the best of NOPA living with easy access to Golden Gate Park, Panhandle, Buena Vista Park, Alamo Square and USF. This wonderful home is not to be missed.
